_comment: The lobby's critical surfaces, read by .agents/scripts/scope_check.py (SCC-443). A path ending in / is a prefix; anything else is an exact repo-relative file. Five keys are always present; a surface that does not apply here says so in its why and lists nothing.

auth.why: the lobby has no auth or session code - nothing to list

billing.why: the lobby bills nothing - nothing to list

rules.why: the lobby has no Firestore or Storage rules and no data topology - nothing to list

answers.why: the lobby serves no FAA-facing answers - nothing to list

ci.why: the gates: a workflow, hook, preflight or permission edit changes what green means for every lane in every repo
